name: @playliquid/platform-achievements
description: PlayLiquid GameOS achievements service (PL-015). Achievement awarding over @playliquid/platform-contracts (AchievementDefinition/AchievementEventBinding declaration shapes, AchievementProgress records, evaluateUnlock as THE unlock oracle, AchievementQueryRequest/ProgressPage read shapes): condition evaluation as pure predicates over event evidence, award-once semantics with evidence-keyed idempotency (E10: re-application returns the recorded result, never a second mutation), progress tracking with monotonic accumulation, and tenant isolation with least-privilege capability grants (R20). Pure domain: the service instance is the single mutable-state owner; persistence, time and grants live behind ports with in-memory fakes; no IO, no timers, no globals.
